subject: table: Add `PessimisticLazyDupKeyCheckMode` to determine lazy mode in pessimistic txn (#55360)
summary: Adds a new table-layer option `PessimisticLazyDupKeyCheckMode` (AcquireLock vs Prewrite) to control where lazy duplicate-key checks happen in pessimistic transactions. The executor computes the mode from session vars (`tidb_constraint_check_in_place_pessimistic`, explicit txn, non-restricted, user connection) and passes it into `AddRecord`/`UpdateRecord`, while the table/index code uses the option (plus `txn.IsPessimistic()` and existing lazy-check conditions) to decide whether to set `kv.SetNeedConstraintCheckInPrewrite`. Also removes `GetSessionVars` from `table/context.MutateContext` and adds targeted KV-flag tests.
